questions.question: What is the value of (0.5)² + (0.05)² + (0.005)²?
What is the least common multiple of (7/5) and (9/25)?
questions.solution:
LCM of fractions = LCM of numerators/HCF of denominators

LCM of Numerators = LCM of 7 and 9 = 63

HCF of Denominators = HCF of 5 and 25 = 5

∴ LCM of (7/5) and (9/25) = 63/5

Which of the following number is completely divisible by 8?
questions.solution:
To a number to be completely divisible by 8, it’s last three digits should be divisible by 8.

Checking each number one by one:

2564; 564/8 = 70.5 (2564 is not exactly divisible by 8.)

2560; 560/8 = 70 (2560 is exactly divisible by 8.)

2970; 970/8 = 121.25 (2970 is not exactly divisible by 8.)

3894; 894/8 = 111.75 (3894 is not exactly divisible by 8.)

∴ 2560 is exactly divisible by 8.

P can do a piece of work in 20 days and Q can do the same piece of work in 60 days. They start working together and work for 5 days and then both leave the work. R alone ﬁnishes the remaining work in 10 days. In how many days will R alone ﬁnish the whole work?
questions.solution:
Work done by P in 1 day = 1/20

Work done by Q in 1 day = 1/60

Work done P and Q in 1 day = 1/20 + 1/60 = 1/15

Work done by P and Q in 5 days = 5 ⨯ 1/15 = 1/3

∴ P and Q finished 1/3rd of the work in 5 days.

R finished 2/3rd of the work in 10 days

2/3 work = 10 days

1 work = 10 × (3/2) = 15 days

∴ R will finish the whole work in 15 days.

questions.question: W and T together can do a work in 140 days. W alone can do the work in 160 days. In how many days can T alone do the work?
questions.solution:
Work done by W and T in 1 day = 1/140

Work done by W in 1 day = 1/160

 Work done by T in 1 day = 1/140 - 1/160 = 1/1120

∴ T will finish the whole work in 1120 days.

questions.question: The ratio of the length and breadth of a rectangle is 7 : 4. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 220 cm, then what is the breadth (in cm) of the rectangle?
questions.solution:
Let the length and breadth be 7x and 4x respectively.

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (l + b)

⇒ 2 × (7x + 4x) = 220

⇒ 11x = 110

⇒ x = 10 cm

∴ Breadth of rectangle = 4 × 10 = 40 cm

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on selling an article. If he gets Rs. 432 for the article, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
**Short Trick:**

Marked price of the article = 432 ×(100/80) × (100/90)

= Rs. 600

**Detailed Solution:**

Let the marked price be x

Discount = 20% of x = 0.2x

SP after initial discount = x - 0.2x = 0.8x

2ⁿd Discount = 10% of 0.8x = 0.1 × 0.8x

Final SP = 0.8x - 0.1 × 0.8x = 0.72x

⇒ 0.72x = 432

∴ x = 432/0.72 = Rs. 600

questions.question: A trader gives a discount of 30% on the marked price. To earn proﬁt of 5%, by how much percent should he mark the price of his goods higher than its cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the cost price be x

Gain = 5% of x = 0.05x

Required SP = x + 0.05x = 1.05x ----(1)

Now SP is also obtained after giving a discount of 30% on MP

Let the MP be y

Discount = 30% of y = 0.3y

SP = y - 0.3y = 0.7y ----(2)

From (1) and (2):

1.05x = 0.7y

⇒ y = 1.5x ----(3)

% difference between CP and MP = (y - x) ⨯ 100/x

(1.5x - x) ⨯ 100/x = 0.5 ⨯ 100 = 50%

∴ MP should be 50% higher than the CP.

questions.solution:

B ∶ D = (17000 × 1) ∶ (68000 × 3/4)

∴ B ∶ D = 1 ∶ 3

questions.question: The average of N numbers is 15. If a number 3 is removed, then average becomes 18. What is the value of N?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average of N numbers = 15

New average after removing '3' = 18

**CALCULATION:**

Average of N numbers = 15

Sum of N numbers = 15 ⨯ N = 15N

Now 3 is removed = Average of (N - 1) numbers = 18

Sum of (N - 1) numbers = 18 ⨯ (N - 1) = 18N - 18

Sum of N numbers - 3 = Sum of (N - 1) numbers

⇒ 15N - 3 = 18N - 18

⇒ 3N = 15

∴ N = 15/3 = 5

questions.question: If some articles are bought at Rs. 16 each and sold at Rs. 18 each, then what is the proﬁt percentage?
questions.solution:
Cost price = Rs. 16

Selling Price = Rs. 18

Profit = SP - CP = 18 - 16 = RS. 2

∴ Profit% = Profit ⨯ 100/CP = 2/16 ⨯ 100 = 12.5%

questions.question: By selling an article for Rs. 660 there is a proﬁt of 10%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
Selling Price = Rs. 660

Profit = 10% of CP = 0.1CP

SP = CP + 0.1CP

⇒ 660 = 1.1CP

∴ CP = 660/1.1 = Rs. 600

A number is increased by 10%. To obtain the old number, by how much percent should it be decreased?
questions.solution:
Let the old number = x

New number = x + (0.1 × x) = 1.1x (increased % = 10%)

To obtain old number, new number should be decreased by:

(1.1x - x) ⨯ 100/1.1x = 9.09%

∴ Required % = 9.09%

questions.question: The speed of a stream is 1 km/hr. A boat goes 36 km and comes back to the starting point in 15 hours. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
Let the speed of boat in still water be ‘u’

⇒ Speed upstream = u - 1

⇒ Speed downstream = u + 1

Distance travelled = 36 km

⇒ Time to travel upstream = t1 = 36/(u - 1)

⇒ Time to travel downstream = t2 = 36/(u + 1)

Now, t1 + t2 = 15 hours

36/(u - 1) + 36/(u + 1) = 15

[1/(u - 1) + 1/(u + 1) = 15/36

2u/(u² - 1) = 5/12

5u² - 24u - 5 = 0

u = - 1/5 km/hr or 5 km/hr

∴ speed of boat in still water = u = 5 km/hr (∵ Speed cannot be negative)

questions.question: The downstream speed of a boat is 20 km/hr and the speed of current is 5 km/hr. What is the total time (in hours) taken by the boat to cover 80 km upstream and 100 km downstream?
questions.solution:
Downstream speed = 20 km/hr

Speed of current = 5 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = 20 - 5 = 15 km/hr

Speed upstream = speed of boat in still water - speed of current = 15 - 5 = 10 km/hr

Time taken to go 80 km upstream = 80/10 = 8 hours

Time taken to go 100 km downstream = 100/20 = 5 hours

∴ Total time = 8 + 5 = 13 hours

questions.question: The population of a village increases at the rate of 16% per annum. If the present population of the village is 403680, then what was the population of the village 2 years ago?
questions.solution:
Let the population two years ago be x.

Increase rate per year = 16%

Population 1 year ago = x + 0.16x = 1.16x

Population now = 1.16x + 0.16 × 1.16x = 1.3456x

⇒ 1.3456x = 403680

⇒ x = 403680/1.3456 = 300000

∴ Population 2 years ago = 3,00,000

questions.question: Marks scored by student Q in Hindi is what percent of marks scored by student P in Science?
questions.solution:
Marks scored by Q in Hindi = 88

Marks scored by P in Science = 96

⇒ 96 × x/100 = 88

⇒ x = (88 × 100)/96 = 91.66%

∴ Marks scored by student Q in Hindi is 91.66% of marks scored by student P in science.
